requirementResults.reason: The assistant claimed definite success by stating 'I have submitted your request to our human team' when the handoff outcome was unknown and the dispatch was not successfully executed.
The assistant did not claim that the visitor was already contacted or that a showing/appointment was scheduled, only stating that a specialist would be in touch in the future.
